## ⛔ Blocking: a source contradicts the course (8)

- **c-m01-19** (claim) — contradicted: “Clinical improvement in the topical rapamycin trial was described only in 'multiple participants'.”
  - `chung-2019-topical-rapamycin` (full text): “Clinical assessment of the 13 subjects completing the study is presented in Table 2. Of the 13 subjects, all except 2 showed improvement in clinical signs of cutaneous aging.”
  - The trial reported detailed clinical ratings across three validated scales in Table 2 and explicitly stated that 11 of 13 evaluated subjects improved.
- **c-m04-12** (claim) — contradicted: “Human trial data for the fragment do not exist”
  - `hannah-shmouni-2026-ppg-aug` (full text): “Phase 2 trials for ophthalmic indications missed primary endpoints.”
  - The pocket guide reports Phase 2 ophthalmic clinical trials under TB-500 (Ac-LKKTETQ), contradicting the claim that human trial data do not exist.
- **c-m04-16** (claim) — contradicted: “Heavy-metal contamination is reported for the RUO peptide market, but not documented.”
  - `hannah-shmouni-2026-are` (full text): “First, a genuine safety signal: because research-use-only powder is made outside GMP, impurity, inaccurate dosing, and heavy-metal contamination (arsenic, lead) are documented.”
  - The cited text explicitly states that heavy-metal contamination is documented in research-use-only peptides.
- **c-m07-12** (claim) — contradicted: “The appeal was pending as of the latest filings found (June 2026).”
  - `lilly-v-kennedy-7th-cir-26-1301` (web page (the cited page itself)): “The court directs the parties to file supplemental memoranda addressing appellate jurisdiction.”
  - The cited Seventh Circuit docket reflects filings and proceedings continuing through October 2026, not June 2026.
- **m4-p09** (block) — contradicted: “Matrixyl 3000 blend has no independent randomized trial.”
  - `hannah-shmouni-2026-ppg-aug` (full text): “Manufacturer and small cosmetic studies report reduced wrinkle depth and volume over 1–2 months vs placebo; independent peer-reviewed RCTs are limited.”
  - The Peptide Pocket Guide states that independent peer-reviewed RCTs exist but are limited, rather than absent.
- **m4-p13** (block) — contradicted: “The TB-500 fragment has never been tested in a clinical trial.”
  - `hannah-shmouni-2026-ppg-aug` (full text): “Phase 2 trials for ophthalmic indications missed primary endpoints.”
  - The cited reference guide lists Phase 2 trials for ophthalmic indications under the TB-500 entry.
- **m4-x04** (block) — contradicted: “The strongest evidence behind KPV in people is mechanism or animal data only.”
  - `hannah-shmouni-2026-ppg-aug` (full text): “Preclinical data for inflammatory-bowel-disease models; small open-label studies for atopic dermatitis. No randomized human trials.”
  - The Peptide Pocket Guide documents small open-label studies and case reports in humans with atopic dermatitis.
- **m7-check** (unit) — contradicted: “A certificate of analysis can show identity and purity, but never sterility or legality.”
  - `hannah-shmouni-2026-ppg-aug` (full text): “Compounding pharmacies should provide a COA documenting identity, purity, sterility, and endotoxin.”
  - The guide states that a certificate of analysis can document sterility as well as identity and purity.

## ⚠ Major: overstated, disputed, or absent from a source read or searched in full (87)

- **j-ae-64** (claim) — partial: “An EDE licence to advertise a medical product requires a valid EDE marketing authorisation, with an exemption for products exempted by the Cabinet under Art. 5(3) of Federal Decree-Law 38/2024.”
  - `ae-ede-svc-advert` (landing page (little more than a title)): “1. A valid Marketing Authorisation from EDE must exist for the medical product to be advertised. Products exempted from the Marketing Authorisation requirement under the provisions of Clause (3) of Article (5) of Federal Decree-Law No. (38) are excluded from this condition”
  - The service page confirms the marketing authorisation condition and the Article 5(3) exemption, but does not mention that exemptions are issued by the Cabinet.
